scope: At least one outcome scenario per named face; not exhaustive interaction, random distribution, balance, or thematic verification.

numeric.test_name: matches printed numeric card outcomes under Ward, weakness, statuses, and mana caps

draw.test_name: draw and Scry faces obey printed counts, ordering, hand cap, mana and source disposition

scry.test_name: pure Scry follows an empty library without revealing or reshuffling the discard pile

return-discard.test_name: fixed discard returns use the printed end and preserve faces, including an empty pile
return-discard.effect_pattern: ^Return the (?:top|bottom) card of your discard pile to your hand\.$

banish-discard.test_name: pure fixed discard Banish uses the named end and handles an empty pile
banish-discard.effect_pattern: ^Banish the (?:top|bottom) card of your discard pile\.$

self-keep.test_name: self-Keep and self-Flip resolve the original source on its resulting face

whole-hand.test_name: whole-hand Flip, Keep, and facing effects change the other held cards only
whole-hand.effect_pattern: ^(?:Flip your hand\.|Keep your hand\.|Turn your hand to its (?:light|dark) faces\.)$

random-hand.test_name: random Flip and Keep act without replacement and use all available cards
random-hand.effect_pattern: ^(?:Flip|Keep) (?:a random card|\d+ random cards) in your hand\.$

self-tuck.test_name: self-tucking faces move the source before drawing, including an otherwise empty library
self-tuck.effect_pattern: ^Put this card on the bottom of your library\. Draw \d+ cards?\.$

discard-to-library.test_name: fixed discard-to-library operations preserve the printed pile end and block order
discard-to-library.effect_pattern: ^(?:Put the (?:top|bottom) card of your discard pile on top of your library\.(?: Scry\.)?|Put the top 2 cards of your discard pile on top of your library in their current order\.|Put the bottom 2 cards of your discard pile on the bottom of your library\.)$

return-top-two.test_name: top-two discard returns move only what fits, with the top card first
return-top-two.effect_pattern: ^Return the top 2 cards of your discard pile to your hand\.(?: Banish this card\.)?$

restore-discard-face.test_name: discard-face restoration returns the same physical top card on the specified face
restore-discard-face.effect_pattern: ^(?:Flip the top card of your discard pile\.|Turn the top card of your discard pile to its light face\.) Return it to your hand\.$

reverse-scry.test_name: reverse-and-Scry faces reverse only the available top block without a midway reshuffle
reverse-scry.effect_pattern: ^Reverse the top \d+ cards of your library\. Scry\.$

draw-hand-effect.test_name: draw-before-Flip, facing, and Keep effects include the newly drawn card
draw-hand-effect.effect_pattern: ^Draw 1 card\. (?:Flip your hand\.(?: Banish this card\.)?|Turn your hand to its (?:light|dark) faces\. Banish this card\.|Keep your hand\.)$

draw-random-discard.test_name: draw-before-random-discard may discard a newly drawn card

random-discard-payment.test_name: required random hand-discard payments reject before spending and resolve the printed payoff
random-discard-payment.effect_pattern: ^Discard a random card\. (?:Draw \d+ cards?|Heal \d+ HP|Deal \d+ (?:Radiance|Shadow|Growth|Decay|Binding|Release|Fire|Frost|Memory|Oblivion) damage)\.(?: Banish this card\.)?$

hp-payment.test_name: HP payments cannot be lethal and occur before the stated payoff

discard-payment.test_name: discard-pile payments must exist before a printed damage or healing payoff
discard-payment.effect_pattern: ^Banish the (?:top|bottom) card of your discard pile\. (?:Heal \d+ HP|Deal \d+ \w+ damage(?:, ignoring Ward)?)\.(?: Banish this card\.)?$

hush.test_name: pure Hush faces require a suppressible intent and spend their source only on a valid play

reflect.test_name: Reflect faces redirect the next hit once and banish the source
reflect.effect_pattern: ^Reflect the first hit of the enemy's next attack\. Banish this card\.$

water-clock.test_name: Water Clock's draw can fill the vacated slot before self-Keep

exchange.test_name: random exchanges use the printed discard end and leave an empty side unchanged
exchange.effect_pattern: ^Exchange a random card in your hand with the (?:top|bottom) card of your discard pile\.$

remove-status.test_name: single-status removal faces preserve other statuses and resolve healing or draw afterward
remove-status.effect_pattern: ^Remove all your (?:Burn|Poison|Curse)\.(?: (?:Draw \d+ cards?|Heal \d+ HP)\.)?(?: Banish this card\.)?$

shuffle-hand.test_name: shuffle-hand faces clear Keep, draw the stated number, and exclude the resolving source
shuffle-hand.effect_pattern: ^Shuffle your hand into your library\. Draw \d+ cards?\.(?: Banish this card\.)?$

cleanse-purge.test_name: Cleanse and Purge remove the specified count of whole status kinds, not stacks
cleanse-purge.effect_pattern: ^(?:Cleanse (?:one random harmful status from yourself|all harmful statuses from yourself)\. Heal 3 HP\. Banish this card\.|Purge one random beneficial status from the enemy\.|Purge all beneficial statuses from the enemy\. Banish this card\.)$

heal-draw.test_name: healing-then-draw faces cap HP before drawing and banish their source
heal-draw.effect_pattern: ^Heal \d+ HP\. Draw \d+ cards?\. Banish this card\.$
